On my lunch break, I overheard a Hispanic guy and a Middle Eastern guy talking about their wives. The Hispanic guy was talking about how they cook together every Saturday, but the Middle Eastern guy seemed appalled by the idea of helping to cook, and said that he doesn't even like his wife leaving the house without him when she should be doing housework. Who believes marriage is a partnership?
A. Undetermined
B. The Middle Eastern guy
C. The Hispanic guy
